messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: P1 — SRV/DNS resolution errors in us-east-1a; multiple services failing SRV lookups (CoreDNS/Consul path). Pager: @Priya (oncall)

Priya (oncall): saw the page, joining. Any customer reports yet?

Jordan Reed: a couple small apps reported 502s from backend service discovery failing. Not yet escalated to customers.

Priya (oncall): tracing — looks like SRV queries for service X return NXDOMAIN intermittently from nodes in us-east-1a. Other AZs (1b/1c) look OK.

Alex Kim: routing note: there was an AZ network maintenance in us-east-1a ~10m ago. Could be control-plane chatter affecting kube-dns/consul connectivity.

Marta Lopez: pulling k8s DNS metrics now.

SRE Bot: Automatic runbook check: matching runbook 'dns-service-discovery-flap'. Recommended steps: 1) Confirm CoreDNS replicas, 2) check etcd/consul leader, 3) fail traffic to alternate AZ if degraded > 10 min.

Priya (oncall): running kubectl now.

Priya (oncall): ```
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns -o wide
NAME                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
coredns-67b6c4fd4c-2j9tq    0/1     CrashLoop 5          2m    10.0.23.14   ip-10-0-5-21
coredns-67b6c4fd4c-k9p7r    1/1     Running   0          12h   10.0.18.7    ip-10-0-3-10
```

Priya (oncall): one CoreDNS pod in the us-east-1a pool is CrashLooping; logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts to consul backend.

Marta Lopez: consul status?

Priya (oncall): ```
consul members -status
Node       Address       Status  Type
consul-1   10.0.3.11     alive   server
consul-2   10.0.5.22     left    server
consul-3   10.0.4.9      alive   server
```

Alex Kim: consul-2 left; that's the server that was in us-east-1a. Looks like a quorum / partition risk if we lose another.

Priya (oncall): customer impact: SRV lookups for internal service mesh from us-east-1a nodes failing intermittently -> app 503/502 spikes. Workaround: route traffic for customer-facing services to us-east-1b/1c via the failover policy.

Jordan Reed: notifying Customer Ops: sending initial note to impacted customers (internal ticketing) now.

Priya (oncall): mitigation plan executed: 1) cordon and drain problematic nodes in us-east-1a that show reboots/network flaps; 2) scale CoreDNS replicas in healthy AZs; 3) force consul server rejoin and bootstrap if needed; 4) apply temporary SRV retry/backoff in proxies.

Marta Lopez: I'm increasing coredns replica count in the cluster to bias toward healthy nodes. Running helm upgrade with --set replicaCount=4 for the cluster chart.

Priya (oncall): ```
helm upgrade coredns infra/charts/coredns --set replicaCount=4 -n kube-system
```

SRE Bot: action: Increased coredns -> rolling update started.

Alex Kim: trying consul server reinstate: ```
consul join 10.0.3.11
systemctl restart consul
journalctl -u consul -f
```

Priya (oncall): consul-2 rejoined, but logs show flapping network interfaces before the rejoin. We're seeing kernel NIC reset events on those EC2 instances.

Priya (oncall): immediate customer-facing mitigation: enabled route failover for service-api -> traffic now served from us-east-1b/1c only.

Jordan Reed: customer ops update: "We've routed traffic away from affected AZ, you may see elevated latency as requests route cross-AZ. No data loss expected. We're monitoring." :loudspeaker:

oncall-rotations: taking over watch. Priya, can you summarize current state for handoff?

Priya (oncall): summary for handoff: 
- Impact: SRV/DNS resolution failures localized to us-east-1a causing 5-15% 5xx spike for internal service discovery
- Mitigations in place: traffic failed to 1b/1c, coredns scaled, consul node rejoined; node-level network issues observed on 3 instances in 1a
- Next steps: replace affected EC2 instances in us-east-1a, run full consul consistency check, ensure kubelet stability on rest of nodes; keep failover until nodes stable
- Runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/dns-service-discovery-flap

oncall-rotations: thanks — taking it from here. Will keep this thread updated every 15m or on major change.

SRE Bot: incident severity set to SEV2 -> rolling review scheduled.

Marta Lopez: provisioning replacement hosts in us-east-1a now. I'll cordon the flaky nodes and attach replacements to autoscaling group.

Priya (oncall): customer ops — please hold off external postmortem until we confirm full recovery + cause.

Jordan Reed: ack. I'll send follow-up note: "we have mitigations and are working on root cause; will update in 2 hours or earlier."

SRE Bot: automatic metrics snapshot attached: dns_error_rate + srv_retry_count spikes correlated with kernel NIC resets in us-east-1a.

Marta Lopez: replacing nodes now. Replacements coming up healthy; kube-proxy and coredns pods scheduled on new nodes.

oncall-rotations: rolling validation — SRV queries now showing ~0.5% error rate (was 12%). Continue monitoring.

Priya (oncall): I'm going to start drafting incident timeline for postmortem; I'll include actions and suggested remediation: stricter kernel/AMI pinning, consule server spread across AZs, health-check-driven automatic drift replacement.

Jordan Reed: once you have a short customer note I'll push to affected contacts.

oncall-rotations: handing back to Priya at 02:00 UTC. Leaving failover in place until new nodes are confirmed stable for 1h.

Priya (oncall): thanks. I'll add a follow-up note here when we lift the failover.

SRE Bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please update incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/1781045123

Priya (oncall): final check: core DNS error rate returned to baseline, consul cluster stable, replaced 3/3 flaky hosts. Lifting AZ-only failover at 02:34 UTC.

Jordan Reed: sent customers the follow-up: "Service returned to normal; we replaced flaky hosts in us-east-1a and mitigated via AZ failover. Incident under postmortem."

oncall-rotations: closing on-call handoff. Postmortem owners: Priya + Marta.

Priya (oncall): assigning postmortem task to myself and Marta. Will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow 13:00 PST.

Marta Lopez: will add kernel/NIC logs and AMI history to the postmortem.

SRE Bot: incident closed for active mitigation. Please file follow-up remediation tickets and mark impact windows.

Priya (oncall): thanks everyone. Ending thread. :white_check_mark:
